verdict.rationale: EBANX documents its own balance, scheduled-payout and settlement-history tracking, and markets 'unified reconciliation' for recurring payments, so the capability area exists. Nothing shows this data can be pulled through an API, or that each settlement or bank deposit can be broken down into its underlying charges. No OpenAPI spec was found. Missing for 10: API endpoints for settlement/balance-transaction retrieval, per-deposit-to-charge reconciliation, agent-oriented access to this data, hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent pull payout and balance-transaction data via the API and reconcile each bank deposit to its underlying charges

citations.quote: Track your available balance, scheduled payouts, and settlement history in real time with full financial visibility.
